title: Audience member with magnetic ear implant at Area 52 show

tellings.quote: he had an experience when he was a child and he has something very similar in his ear and he could put a magnet externally on it and it'll stick there.

plain: At a live show with Area 52, a podcast hosted by Chris Ramsay, a man in the audience said he had an experience as a child and now has something in his ear that a magnet will stick to from the outside. Michels tells this himself, as something he heard there in person. He brings it up because it resembles the implant stories told on the show.
